generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder shall have successfully executed HT motor repair / breakdown / servicing / overhauling / reconditioning works of 3.3kV & above motor in any Power Utility / Industrial establishments as a prime contractor, in a single work order not less than total value of Rs. 16 Lakhs (Exclusive of GST) during the preceding five financial years i.e., from 2021-22 to 2025-26. Scanned copies of Work Order & Work Done/Proof for Work Completion reports signed by competent authority should be submitted. For each Work done value for previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year, in which tenders are invited.

The average annual financial turnover of the agency should not be less than Rs. 31.95 Lakhs in any two financial years in preceding five years i.e., from 2021-22 to 2025-26. Scanned copies of statement of accounts certified by chartered accountant should be enclosed as a documentary proof. Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which tenders are invited.
